title: Remove consumed credits from Payables Agent setup
summary: The Payables Agent setup page no longer displays consumed Copilot credits information, and the related calculation code has been removed as part of monetization changes.
key_points: Consumed Copilot credits section removed from Payables Agent setup page
Internal PACostEstimate codeunit deleted as it was only used by removed UI controls
Change aligns with upcoming monetization changes for the Payables Agent
No other references to removed functionality remain in the codebase
Low-risk change with no impact on extensions
quote: Removed the consumed Copilot credits section from the Payables Agent setup page.
